FailoverEvent.description: One home dropping out of an export and the fleet covering for it, for the failover log.

kind.description: `warned`: the home announced it was dropping out; `silent`: detected by missed heartbeats.

cover_s.description: Seconds from drop-out to full cover; null when not covered this tick.

covered_by.description: How many homes picked up the lost output.

FailoverEvent.title: FailoverEvent

available_mw.description: What the fleet could physically export this tick: homes on grid, above reserve floor.

promised_mw.description: MW committed to the utility for this tick: 0 outside calls; null when no commitment source is configured.

delivered_mw.description: Actual fleet discharge to the grid this tick.

utility_call.description: True while the utility has called on the fleet's contracted capacity.

homes_on_grid.description: Homes with grid power this tick, including those exporting.

homes_exporting.description: Homes on grid and discharging to it; a subset of `homes_on_grid`.

homes_on_battery.description: Grid down, battery still powering the house.

homes_dark.description: Grid down and battery empty: lights out (ran out).

homes_dark_by_contract.description: Grid down, tier `none`: the house is unpowered by contract while the battery keeps its energy.

headroom_mwh.description:
Fleet energy above each home's contract reserve at the end of the tick.

During a call this includes what the rest of the call will draw.

revenue_usd.description:
Cumulative net revenue since replay start: `contract_pnl_usd` - `backup_cost_usd` + `market_usd`.
Charging at negative prices earns money.

contract_pnl_usd.description:
Cumulative utility contract P&L: capacity payments + call energy (delivery up to the promise,
at the interval price) - shortfall penalties - the cost of charging homes call-ready for the
next call outside calls (it exists for the contract).

backup_cost_usd.description:
Cumulative cost of charging homes back up to their reserve, whatever the price. Negative if
that charging ran at negative prices.

market_usd.description: Cumulative everything else: exports beyond the promise, minus other charging (cheap fills, pre-charge).

penalty_usd.description: Cumulative shortfall penalties since replay start (shortfall x interval price).

promise_kept.description: Share of called intervals where delivery met the promise, 0-1; null until a call has happened.

failovers_warned.description: Cumulative failovers where the home warned before dropping out.

failovers_silent.description: Cumulative failovers where the home dropped out without warning (missed heartbeats).

failovers_uncovered.description: Cumulative failovers whose lost output no other home could cover.

failover_p50_s.description: Median seconds to cover a failover so far; null until one has been covered.

failover_max_s.description: Slowest cover so far, seconds; null until one has been covered.

HomeInfo.description: Static facts about one home, sent once in `init`.
HomeInfo.title: HomeInfo

HomeState.description: Per-tick state of one home. Joined to `HomeInfo` by `id`.

grid.description: True if the home has grid power this tick.

kw.description: Battery power magnitude; direction comes from `action`.

conf.description: Decision confidence, 0-1; null for rule decisions.

HomeState.title: HomeState

end.description: Exclusive end of the replay window.

params.description: The parameters this replay runs with (defaults filled in).

ReplayParams.description: One replay's knobs: the /ws query params, echoed in `init`.

policy.description: `contract`: keeps both contracts (docs/dispatch-design.md); `naive`: the price-rule baseline.

standard_backup_h.description: Hours of backup the `standard` tier's reserve covers at the forecast temperature.

max_calls_per_day.description: Utility calls that may start per Central-time day.

emergency_uncapped.description: During an EEA a call may start whatever `max_calls_per_day` says (the stress case).

skip_before_storm.description: No call while a severe cold snap is in the next 24 h forecast.

headroom_mode.description:
Contract policy only. `keep`: energy above what the contracts need stays in the batteries;
`sell`: export it when the price spikes.

homes.description: Fleet size. 3,000 homes x 12 kW is 36 MW of nameplate, about Base's 40 MW Austin Energy deal.

spread_by_domain.description:
Contract policy only. Treat each rotating-outage block as a failure domain (⚠ assumes the
operator knows the utility's blocks): split a call evenly across the on-grid domains, then pro
rata inside one, and hold an N-1 buffer (losing the largest domain's share leaves that much
spare on the others) instead of the fixed 20%.

contract.description: Utility contract size, share of fleet nameplate (homes x max kW).

ReplayParams.title: ReplayParams

t.description: Interval start, ISO 8601 with UTC offset.

price.description: Real-time settlement point price, $/MWh. Can be negative.

failovers.description: Failovers that started or resolved this tick, oldest first.

SafeContractCurve.description: Contract size against promise kept and money in one scenario, and the largest safe size.

baseline_critical_ran_out.description: `critical_ran_out` with no utility contract: what the rule compares against.

safe.description:
The largest contract with `kept` >= 0.95 (or no calls) and no more critical homes running
out than with no contract; null if none qualifies.

SafeContractCurve.title: SafeContractCurve

SafeContractPoint.description: One contract size in one scenario, averaged over the seeds.

contract.description: Contract size, share of fleet nameplate.

kept.description:
Share of called intervals kept in the scenario's test window (`uri`: the storm, Feb 14-18;
`normal`: the whole week); null if the window had no calls.

pre_kept.description: `uri` only: the same before the storm (Feb 10-12). Null for `normal`, or with no calls.

contract_pnl_usd.description: Over the whole replay, as in `FleetStats`.

backup_cost_usd.description: Over the whole replay, as in `FleetStats`.

uncovered.description: Failovers no other home could cover, over the whole replay.

critical_ran_out.description: Critical-tier homes whose battery ran out during an outage, over the whole replay.
